objective: Run a signed exact-v5 two-stage open-row mechanics experiment that first re-establishes shadow identity at causal predictor positions and, only after that gate passes, tests detached-shadow/live-value recurrent feedback without changing or saving model weights.

authorization_basis.authorization_scope: separately signed recurrent mechanics design only

hardware.accelerators: exactly four distinct NVIDIA A100 GPUs
hardware.stage2_sharding: hash-selected heldout sources in sorted ordinal round-robin order

stage1_predictor_crossfit.feature_positions: causal predictors selected by labels[:,1:] != -100 and shifted one token left
stage1_predictor_crossfit.feature_shape_per_row: answer_predictor_tokens by 42 layers by 32 state dimensions
conditions: untouched matched-donor recurrent state with target projected carrier
cyclic layer-permuted target recurrent state with target projected carrier
stage1_predictor_crossfit.head: new per-layer identity-plus-rank4 residual bilinear head
stage1_predictor_crossfit.optimizer: AdamW for 512 train-only steps at learning-rate 0.01 and weight-decay 0.001
stage1_predictor_crossfit.thresholds: per-layer midpoint of the train-only 0.05 correct-score quantile and 0.95 max-negative-score quantile

stage2_recurrent_mechanics.execution_gate: run only when every stage1 heldout gate passes
stage2_recurrent_mechanics.rows: exactly the 44 stage1 heldout open rows
stage2_recurrent_mechanics.state_capture: one target write and one matched-donor write per rank batch, followed by detached immutable clones
stage2_recurrent_mechanics.read_invariant: no writes during any baseline, condition, or recurrent pass read
stage2_recurrent_mechanics.identity: detached token-causal predictor-position shadow only gates
stage2_recurrent_mechanics.correction_mask: exactly supervised causal predictor positions; all other token corrections are exact zero
stage2_recurrent_mechanics.feedback: for pass k greater than one, mask pass k-1 detached live RWKV values to causal predictors and inject them one token right through a pre-hook before attention query/read formation

control_semantics.row-shuffled: shuffle only the detached shadow rows while retaining target live recurrent state and target original-v5 fusion
control_semantics.norm-random: replace only the detached shadow with a norm-matched random shadow while retaining target live recurrent state and target original-v5 fusion
control_semantics.fixed-correct-gate donor-value: retain target recurrent state, target original-v5 fusion, correct shadow, and correct gate; substitute the detached donor baseline read only inside the certified binder material-value input and its replay source

stage2_recurrent_mechanics.material_control_gate: At pass one and pass eight, at least 0.95 of heldout rows must have at least 0.95 of supervised predictor-logit vectors differ from correct for donor-shadow, donor-pair, zero, layer-permuted, row-shuffled, norm-random, and fixed-correct-gate donor-value.
stage2_recurrent_mechanics.feedback_and_disabled_gates: Correct-no-feedback must equal correct exactly at pass one and materially differ on at least 0.95 of rows at pass eight; disabled must materially differ on at least 0.95 of rows at both pass one and pass eight.
reports: overall first-token and later-token cross entropy by condition and pass
correct pass two differs from pass one
disabled logits collapse exactly across all passes
target and donor immutable state hashes before and after all reads
per-row predictor-logit changed fractions versus correct at pass one and pass eight
condition-minus-correct overall first-token and later-token cross entropy with positive-row fractions
write_enabled is false after every baseline and condition read

stopping_rule.stage1_fail: stop before installing or running recurrent mechanics
stopping_rule.stage1_pass: run stage2 mechanics only; do not authorize training or generation
stopping_rule.always: open rows only; do not open publisher validation, test, Hard32, strength holdout, or any protected split
